prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is visible, approach it, else scan area. If close, take object, check goodness, move, and do specific task. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = IsGoodObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Action ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ScanArea    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
			IF IsGoodObject? THEN
			DO MoveToDestination
	ELSE
		DO SpecificTask
	END
